Name: Legacy ID
Description: Identifier type to record optional previous identifers

Name: SSN
Format description: Identifier should be 1 letter, followed by a dash and 7 numerical characters. Eg, A-0010902

Name: Unique ART Number
Format description: The patient identifier should match the following format "CES/JHT/00005" or "TI-CES/JHT/00005" for transfer in clients

Name: Unique OPD Number
Description: OutRecord the unique OPD number which is given to each NEW out patient annually and on the first visit for individual identification
Format description: The patient OPD Number should match the following format "CES_JUB_MUN_OPD-0001"

Name: Inpatient Number
Description: Record the unique inpatient number which is given to each patient admitted in the inpatient department for individual identification
Format description: The patient Inpatient Number should match the following format "CES_JUB_MUN_IPD-0001"
